questions.q: What does a DMS replication instance actually do?
options: It's the managed EC2-based compute that runs the migration or replication process, reading from source and writing to target
It's a serverless function triggered once per migration
It stores the target database's data permanently
It only validates schema, never moves data
questions.explain: The replication instance is the compute layer DMS uses to actually perform the read/write work of a migration task.

questions.q: You need to migrate an on-prem Oracle database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. What kind of migration is this, and what extra tool is typically needed first?
options: Heterogeneous — the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT) is typically needed before DMS moves the data
Homogeneous — no extra tooling is needed since both are relational databases
Heterogeneous — but SCT is only for NoSQL targets, not PostgreSQL
This isn't a migration DMS supports at all
questions.explain: Oracle to PostgreSQL is a different-engine (heterogeneous) migration; since schema and data types don't map 1:1, SCT is used to convert schema before DMS handles the actual data movement.

options: A migration between the same database engine on both source and target
A migration that only moves a single table
A migration that requires the Schema Conversion Tool
Any migration that lands data in S3
questions.explain: Homogeneous migrations move data between the same engine (e.g., SQL Server to SQL Server), so schema and data types map directly without conversion tooling.

questions.q: Which two endpoints does a DMS migration task tie together, running on a given replication instance?
options: A source endpoint and a target endpoint
Two source endpoints
A Glue endpoint and a Lambda endpoint
A VPC endpoint and an IAM endpoint
questions.explain: A migration task connects a source endpoint (where data comes from) to a target endpoint (where it lands), executed by the replication instance.

questions.q: What does the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT) do?
options: Analyzes a source schema for a heterogeneous migration, automatically converts what it can, and flags what needs manual rework
Runs the actual full-load data transfer for every DMS migration
Only works for homogeneous migrations
Replaces the need for a replication instance
questions.explain: SCT is a separate tool used ahead of heterogeneous migrations to handle the schema/code conversion that DMS itself doesn't do — DMS focuses on moving the data.
